            // vpkstuff patch: each block takes a 12-byte table entry, so a count past what the
            // stream holds is hostile; check it before reserving the list.
            if (blockCount > (Reader.BaseStream.Length - Reader.BaseStream.Position) / 12)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException($"Resource claims {blockCount} blocks, more than its {Reader.BaseStream.Length} bytes can hold.");
            }

            Blocks.EnsureCapacity((int)blockCount);
